questions.template: A small gear driving a big gear makes the big gear turn…?
questions.explain: Small-driving-big trades speed for turning force.

questions.template: A lever helps you lift because…?
choices: A long arm multiplies your push
questions.hint: The longer the arm, the easier the lift.
questions.explain: Force × distance: a long arm turns a small push into a big lift.

questions.template: A 24-tooth gear drives an 8-tooth gear. The small gear spins…?
questions.explain: Each big turn pushes 24 teeth past; the 8-tooth gear must spin 3 times.

questions.template: Which shape makes a structure strongest?
questions.hint: It has no way to lean!
questions.explain: Triangles can't change shape without changing side lengths — that's rigidity.

questions.template: To balance 60 blocks at 2 arms, you could use…?
questions.hint: Multiply weight × arms on each side — they must match: 60 × 2 = 120.
questions.explain: 40 × 3 = 120 = 60 × 2 — balanced! The lever law in action.

questions.template: The middle gear in a three-gear train changes…?
questions.hint: They call it an idler — it just passes the motion along.
questions.explain: An idler flips direction; speed depends only on the first and last gears.
